observed_failures.bmc_health_start: INTERNAL_ERROR: BMC health check could not be started

documented_requirement: DPS 0.9 requires an active topology for both check connection and verify bmc-health start. skip-writes only controls the health task, not topology activation.
activation_effect: Activation applies the topology effective policy or invokes unset/idle fallback even without resource groups. The stored topology selects the built-in MaxLPS bundle.
documentation_discrepancy: General installation and BMC health pages describe checking an imported inactive topology; more specific DPS 0.9 connection reference, troubleshooting, and Agent API definitions require active topology. Actual observed behavior matches the specific references.
agent_routing_correction: Move 72 AgentId values to Topology.Entities. This corrects routing metadata but does not remove the active-topology requirement.
non_mutating_evidence_available: Control-plane checks and independent Pod-to-BMC reads can be retained separately; they do not substitute for DPS-to-Agent-to-BMC integration.
